milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to navigate near the target and visually observe it. The spruce sapling is at spawn-relative [4, 0, 6]. The player spawns ~7.2 blocks away (exceeding max_distance=5), so they must walk toward the sapling. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the sapling, not just passing nearby.

Uses inventory_has because crafting sticks places them directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with zero sticks (only a crafting table in inventory), so min_count=1 cannot be pre-satisfied. The crafting chain is: mine spruce_log → craft to spruce_planks (in 2x2 grid) → craft 2 planks vertically to get 4 sticks. Even 1 log yields enough planks for 4 sticks, so min_count=1 is easily achievable.
